symptoms: Paediatric acute gastroenteritis with vomiting +/- diarrhoea.
Dehydration status: None, Some 5%, Severe 10%, Shocked.

management_steps.details: Tolerating oral fluids + feeds. Reassure, ORS @ home, health education, D/C home.

Oral challenge / ORS / dilute apple juice / breast milk trial. ORS Initiation: <10kg = 5ml PO / 5 min; >10kg = 10ml PO / 10 min. Continuation: <10kg = 10ml PO / 5 min; >10kg = 20ml PO / 5 min. Re-assess hydration every 30 mins. If not tolerating orally, consider NGT or place IV/IO short line.
Call for help, resus bay, monitors. Crystalloid (R/L or Balsol) 20mL/kg IVI/IO STAT. Repeat 10-20ml/kg boluses to max 40mL/kg. Consider septic shock VBG, FBC, U+E.
Kids > 6mo with vomiting + not tolerating orally: consider Ondansetron 0.15mg/kg (maximum 8mg).

warnings: Caution for respiratory compromise with further fluid boluses in shocked patients.
